## Teaching points

1. A sudden pop, loss of push-off and abnormal calf-squeeze test support complete Achilles rupture.
2. Some plantarflexion and flat-footed walking can remain despite a complete rupture.
3. Use the calf-squeeze test and clinical findings; avoid turning a straightforward diagnosis into a mandatory imaging exercise.
4. Protect the ankle in the position specified by the local tendon pathway and arrange prompt specialist review, with an individualized thrombosis assessment.
